name: hawl
description: HAWL - CECIT College Task Management System

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @hawl/shared && npm run dev -w @hawl/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @hawl/shared && npm run dev -w @hawl/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hawl/shared && npm run build -w @hawl/api && npm run build -w @hawl/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hawl/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hawl/api && npm run typecheck -w @hawl/web
